text:
lauren: Quick sync — final gating thread for marketplace staging cutover tomorrow 18:00 UTC. Need: legal press copy signoff, SI onboarding confirm, landing page assets uploaded, and a final dry-run. Notion page: https://notion.redwood/marketplace/staging-runbook

matt: I can take legal signoff. looping sarah-legal now. ETA noon PT.

selena: Assets are uploaded to S3 -> s3://redwood-marketplace/staging/assets. Still missing localized CTA for APAC (zh, ja). olivia?

olivia: on it — will have zh/ja CTAs by 08:00 UTC tomorrow.

raj: SI onboarding checklist — 90% done. Need SI partner integration keys from hw-partner-ops. pinged them. If we don't have keys by 14:00 UTC we fallback to demo mode.

sarah-legal: reviewed press copy. Two small asks: (1) remove comparative language on page 2, (2) add standard privacy blurb. I've left comments in the doc. Approve after changes.

lauren: thanks. matt, can you incorporate Sarah's comments and post final copy here by 11:30 UTC?

matt: yep, will paste final below when done.

launch-bot: Reminder: staging deploy window opens 2024-06-12T18:00:00Z. Runbook step 2 requires "assets verified" and "legal signoff" flags true.

lauren: Dry-run plan — quick checklist for tomorrow morning (please react with :white_check_mark: when done):
- lauren: confirm legal signoff
- matt: paste final press copy here
- selena: confirm localized CTAs uploaded
- raj: confirm SI keys or demo-mode fallback set
- olivia: smoke test landing (visual QA)
- launch-bot: run smoke deploy to staging and post status

matt: Final press copy (post-legal):
"Redwood Inference announces general availability of the Marketplace listing, enabling customers to provision Dedicated and Private deployments directly via partner catalogs. The solution provides unified observability, predictable performance, and enterprise controls. For more details, visit the Redwood Marketplace page."

lauren: Matt — the copy looks good to me. thanks. tagging product for optional quote: @selena

selena: happy to provide a short quote. pasted: "Redwood Marketplace makes it simple for teams to deploy inference with predictable cost and enterprise-grade controls."

lauren: ok. status update in order:
- legal signoff: sarah-legal (done) :white_check_mark:
- press copy: matt (done) :white_check_mark:
- localized CTAs: olivia (in progress)
- assets in S3: selena (done) :white_check_mark:
- SI keys: raj (pending hw-partner-ops)

raj: hw-partner-ops responded: keys expected 13:45 UTC. I'm preparing fallback instructions. If keys not received we switch SI installs to test-mode by setting env var `SI_DEMO=true` in the partner deployment.

lauren: good. olivia — ping once CTAs are uploaded and attach small screenshot of each locale.

olivia: uploaded and screenshots attached to Notion. smoke-tested on Chrome/mobile — looks fine. :iphone: :white_check_mark:

lauren: final preflight instructions for launch engineer (copy-paste):
```
# staging cutover steps
1) Ensure launch-bot status: assets=true, legal=true
2) run `./scripts/deploy_staging.sh --catalog marketplace --assets s3://redwood-marketplace/staging/assets`
3) wait for smoke status from launch-bot (should report `smoke: pass`)
4) if SI keys missing, set `SI_DEMO=true` and notify partners
5) post final go/no-go in this thread
```

lauren: Who's on the war-room for the window? volunteer pls.

matt: I'll be on call for legal/press fallbacks 17:30–19:00 UTC.

raj: SI lead 17:30–19:30 UTC.

selena: product ops 17:30–18:30 UTC.

olivia: visual QA 17:30–18:15 UTC.

lauren: perfect. launch-bot, please post a 30-min warning and run the preflight at T-15.

launch-bot: Acknowledged — posting reminders: T-30m, T-15m, T+5m. Preflight scheduled at 2024-06-12T17:45:00Z.

matt: one last check: embargo timing for press? we release the blog at 18:10 UTC and post social at 18:15 UTC — is that still the plan?

lauren: yes. blog publish 18:10, social 18:15, press outreach at 18:20. legal confirmed embargo windows.

raj: keys arrived early — got them at 13:30 UTC. SI onboarding will be full run.

lauren: awesome. final status: legal ✅, assets ✅, local CTAs ✅, SI keys ✅. moving to staging deploy. I'll post go/no-go here after smoke.

launch-bot: Deploy started. logs: https://ci.redwood/12345

selena: smoke: pass. landing renders, links wired, analytics firing.

lauren: GO. launching blog/social at 18:10/18:15. thanks everyone!! :party_parrot:

matt: great job team.

olivia: nice one!

raj: congrats — closing loop with partners.
